answer: Each agent stakes a unique opal token locked to its verified hardware root, and every new identity must be endorsed at a jetty checkpoint where a bonded peer co-signs after an in-person key exchange. Sybil farmers then must acquire scarce opals and real endorsers per identity, so a ripple of fake accounts costs linearly more stake than the rewards it can extract, making mass forgery economically irrational.
